lines: One hundred and six Hegemony soldiers fell. One hundred and twenty-two from Concord.
Three hundred and thirty-six lie wounded. A thirty-bed field hospital opens tomorrow.
This is Cyril Doc Zaboravljeni. He signed up on the first morning, and he is the last one still standing.
On Day eleven, raiders came through the wire, and he was shot.
The medics got him to the hospital. Two days later, he was back.
On Day sixteen, they made him lance corporal.
Last night he won a bet at R F twelve. Two enemy soldiers came for him. Both went down.
Four medals. Seventeen days. And he is still here.
Forty-six new soldiers came up the line. Two thousand three hundred and thirty-eight hold it now.
Pick a side. Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD, and your soldier joins the war.
